ivfStoriesPage.eyebrow: Success Stories Of Patients Who Got Pregnant Through IVF
ivfStoriesPage.title: Real IVF Success Stories
ivfStoriesPage.subtitle: Our patients have conceived at our clinic using IVF, from all over India and abroad. With blastocyst culture, PGT-A and better endometrial lining, for reasons such as blocked tubes, male infertility and failed previous IVF cycles, to name a few. Below are some of their IVF success stories.

items.title: The Verma family got a child on their first IVF transfer
items.story: They had secondary infertility for the past 4 years. No obvious cause could be identified for the couple. They had tried IVF twice previously at two other centres and failed both times. They decided to take IVF at our centre with Dr Mona Dahiya. She stimulated her ovaries correctly and performed a blastocyst culture. The patient gave birth to a baby boy.

items.title: Got pregnant after IVF with blocked tubes
items.story: She lost all hope of having a child of her own. When both her tubes were found to be blocked, she and her husband visited our centre. By performing a single embryo transfer and following IVF protocol Dr Mona was able to give Suman and Deepak their daughter.

items.title: Multiple failed IVF cycles previously
items.story: Kavita and Alok approached Dr. Dahiya after several failed embryo transfers. After performing immune based protocols to treat the factors that effect implantation and confirming her endometrial receptivity, Dr Dahiya helped her conceive on her first transfer. She eventually delivered a healthy baby girl.

items.title: Infertility caused by male factor led to conception
items.story: As his sperm count was low they were unable to fertilize enough eggs. So we suggested them to undergo ICSI along with the IVF procedure which resulted in good quality embryos. They eventually had twins.

items.title: She Was Close to Turning 40
items.story: She believed that because she was near 40 with low AMH levels and deteriorating quality of her eggs that there was nothing more that could be done. However Dr Mona Dahiya followed a less invasive protocol and was able to collect good quality eggs from her over time. A healthy embryo was formed and she gave birth to a baby boy just after her 40th birthday.

items.title: Motherhood After Being Diagnosed With Stage 4 Endometriosis
items.story: With many years of pelvic pain and compromised fallopian tubes due to stage 4 endometriosis. She visited several specialists however no one could help. After consulting with Dr Dahiya a medication plan was made to reduce her inflammation and proceed with IVF. She was able to give birth to a healthy baby girl.

items.title: Baby Finally Arrives After 10 Years
items.story: The Bakhshi family had dreamed of having a child for the past decade. They tried numerous times without success. Dr Mona Dahiya discovered a small hormonal imbalance during their consultation that was not detected by other physicians. She was able to become pregnant on her first frozen embryo transfer and gave birth to a baby boy.

items.title: Welcoming Their Rainbow Baby
items.story: Experiencing 3 miscarriages left this couple devastated and scared to become pregnant again. Dr Mona Dahiya took time to run various tests prior to transferring to get to the root of the problem. She was able to carry the baby until 38 weeks and had a healthy baby girl.

items.title: She Had No Reason To Not Become Pregnant
items.story: All the tests that came back for the Malhotra family were completely normal. But still could not conceive a child. Once IVF began Dr Mona Dahiya realized that there was poor fertilization occurring with the patients. So changes were made to help promote fertilization between the egg and sperm. She became pregnant on the first transfer and gave birth to a baby boy.

items.title: Flying Thousands Of Miles For Their Baby Girl
items.story: After failing at multiple attempts to conceive at home. Sarah & David flew to India to speak with Dr Mona Dahiya. An IVF cycle was performed and we were able to perform blastocyst culture. After returning home she gave birth to a healthy baby girl.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions: IVF Success Stories

items.q: Are these stories from real patients?
items.a: Below are actual people that have gone through Dr Mona Dahiya for treatment. Feel free to view their reviews. Each case will give different results.

items.q: How does Dr. Mona Dahiya help after failed IVF?
items.a: We can analyse your failed cases. Do a PGT-A on your frozen embryos. Scan your lining on USG (3D SIS) or through Hysteroscopy. Perform CD138 biopsy, find out if your husband has DNA fragmentation. And ERA Testing.

items.q: How many embryos are transferred?
items.a: We normally transfer only one blastocyst. This increases your chances and decreases twin pregnancies. Chance of twin is less than 5%.

items.q: What is the IVF success rate?
items.a: More than 90% with IVF. It will depend on each individual's case.

items.q: Are frozen transfers as successful as fresh?
items.a: Your embryos have greater than 95% survival rate when thawed. So you can expect the same or better results with Frozen embryo transfers.

items.q: Can blocked tubes affect IVF?
items.a: If you have hydrosalpinx it may lower your chances. Removing them is recommended.

items.q: What is PGT-A?
items.a: Your embryos will be tested before transfer for any chromosome defects. No you can't choose gender with IVF, it's illegal.

items.q: How much does IVF cost?
items.a: It depends on each case. Average would be between 1.5 lakhs and 2.5 lakhs. EMI available. See

items.a: You can visit our location at Noida Sector 49, Raj Nagar Ghaziabad and Lajpat Nagar Delhi. Mon-Sat 10 am to 5 pm.

leftFaqs.question: Who offers the best IVF treatment in India?
leftFaqs.answer: Dr. Mona Dahiya can help you with your journey to parenthood with affordable price and high success rate in India.

leftFaqs.question: What is the success rate of IVF in India?
leftFaqs.answer: IVF has success rate of approximately 40%-60% in India. It may vary with the age of women and type of infertility you have. Dr Mona Dahiya has an IVF success rate of 90%+.

leftFaqs.question: What age is good for IVF?
leftFaqs.answer: Every woman is different but typically women in their 20s and early 30s will have better chances of getting pregnant. It decreases with age.

leftFaqs.question: Is IVF safe after 35?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes you can have IVF after 35 years of age. But your chances decrease as you age. There are some techniques that can increase your chance of success.

leftFaqs.question: How many IVF cycles are needed to get pregnant?
leftFaqs.answer: Everyone is different some will conceive in their first cycle and some may take longer than that. Age and Type of Infertility can effect this.

leftFaqs.question: Which month is best for IVF?
leftFaqs.answer: There is no particular month for doing IVF. You can get it done anytime of the year based on your period.

rightFaqs.question: Is IVF harmful or beneficial?
rightFaqs.answer: IVF can help you conceive a baby. However there can be side effects such as Multiple pregnancy, Ovarian hyper stimulation and stress from the treatment. All these side effects are very rare if the IVF procedure is done by an expert IVF specialist like Dr Mona Dahiya.

rightFaqs.question: How safe is IVF pregnancy in India?
rightFaqs.answer: If proper protocol is followed then IVF baby is perfectly safe. Make sure to consult the right fertility doctor like Dr Mona Dahiya.

rightFaqs.question: How can I share my medical records?
rightFaqs.answer: You can send us your report on email, whatsapp before your appointment.

rightFaqs.question: What if I don't have previous medical records?
rightFaqs.answer: We can do initial basic tests that are required to plan your treatment.

rightFaqs.question: Which documents should I carry for treatment?
rightFaqs.answer: Passport original, passport size photo and old report (if any) should be there with you.

rightFaqs.question: What is the Indian country code?

items.a: Yes. Dr Mona can prescribe you supplements, medicine to stimulate ovulation, and recommend tests that you can complete at home. However, actual procedures cannot be recommended over video, and you would need to be present at clinic to complete them.

items.q: What if I do not have recent test reports?
items.a: Yes. Dr Mona will ask you about your symptoms as well as past pregnancies or births. Based on those she will recommend the most important tests required to evaluate your fertility. Treatment plans are ONLY recommended by Dr. Mona after these tests have been evaluated.

items.q: Can my spouse join from a different location?
items.a: Yes. Zoom or Google Meet allow for multiple people to join the same call. If you and your partner live in different cities or are busy with work, you both can attend the consultation.

items.q: How much does an online consultation cost?
items.a: Online Consultation costs ₹1000 for Indian patients and $25 USD for international patients. Payment is securely processed through PayPal before the consultation takes place.

items.q: How long is the consultation?
items.a: A half hour private virtual consultation with Dr Dahiya followed by a consultation report via email. Consultation reports are emailed to you or sent via WhatsApp message. This usually takes 2 hours.

items.q: When will I receive my treatment plan?
items.a: Usually within 2 hours of the call, by email or WhatsApp.

items.q: What are the booking hours?
items.a: Consultation hours are Monday to Saturday from 10AM-5PM IST.

items.q: Can an online consultation replace in-clinic tests?
items.a: No. While we can answer questions regarding your fertility and give you a customized treatment plan moving forward, you will still need to be present in clinic to complete procedures. IVF medications, scans, egg retrieval and embryo transfer all need to be done in person.

items.q: Is my information kept confidential?
items.a: No. Only staff and doctors that are involved with your treatment will have access to your records.
items.linkLabel: Click here to read our Privacy Policy.

items.q: Can I book a follow-up online consultation?
items.a: Yes. Follow-up appointments can be booked in the same way as your initial consultation. Many of our patients review their new test results with Dr Mona over video before they fly into India for their treatment.

items.q: What is the difference between conventional IVF and ICSI?
items.a: In IVF, eggs and thousands of prepared sperm are placed together in a dish. In ICSI, an embryologist injects one selected sperm into each egg, which overcomes severe male factor and past fertilisation failure.

items.q: How long does one complete IVF cycle take?
items.a: About 12 to 14 days of stimulation from Day 2 of the period to egg retrieval. A frozen transfer adds 2 to 3 weeks of lining preparation, then a blood test 14 days later.

items.q: Is egg retrieval painful?
items.a: No. It takes 15 to 20 minutes under light IV sedation, so you sleep through it. Mild cramping afterwards settles with simple painkillers.

items.q: How many hormone injections are needed?
items.a: Small injections under the skin once a day for 8 to 11 days, using ultra-fine needles like insulin pens.

items.q: Do I need to stay in hospital?
items.a: No. Egg retrieval and embryo transfer are day-care procedures, and most women go home within 2 to 3 hours.

items.q: Which tests are needed before IVF?
items.a: AMH with an antral follicle scan, semen analysis, a uterine scan, hormone tests (TSH, prolactin) and infection screening for both partners.

items.q: When will I know if IVF worked?
items.a: A blood Beta-hCG test 14 days after transfer (or 12 to 14 days after a blastocyst transfer).

items.q: Is strict bed rest needed after embryo transfer?
items.a: No. Studies show bed rest does not improve implantation, and embryos cannot fall out. Rest 15 to 20 minutes at the clinic, then resume normal, non-strenuous activity.

items.q: How many embryos should be transferred?
items.a: Usually 1. Dr. Dahiya prefers elective single blastocyst transfer, which keeps pregnancy rates high while reducing risks of preterm birth and twins.

items.q: Are frozen transfers as effective as fresh transfers?
items.a: Yes. Vitrified embryos survive warming over 95% of the time, and frozen transfers often do as well or better because the lining is prepared without high stimulation hormones.

items.q: Does IVF increase the risk of birth defects?
items.a: The large majority of IVF babies are healthy. Some studies show a small increase in risk, mostly linked to the underlying infertility rather than IVF itself, and Dr. Dahiya discusses this at consultation.

items.q: What is OHSS and how is it prevented?
items.a: Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome is an over-response to stimulation. It is prevented with antagonist protocols, careful dosing, an agonist trigger and freeze-all cycles when needed.

items.q: Can I work during IVF?
items.a: Yes. Most women keep working through stimulation and take 1 to 2 days off around egg retrieval.

items.q: What should I avoid after transfer?
items.a: Heavy lifting, intense exercise, smoking, alcohol and hot tubs until the pregnancy test.

items.q: Can I have IVF with my own eggs if my AMH is below 0.5 ng/mL?
items.a: Yes. AMH reflects egg numbers, not quality. Tailored protocols such as DuoStim or Mini IVF help many women with low AMH conceive with their own eggs.

items.q: What causes recurrent implantation failure?
items.a: Mainly chromosomal errors in embryos, hidden chronic endometritis (CD138 biopsy), uterine defects or a displaced implantation window (detected by the ERA Test).

items.q: What is the success rate of IVF with Dr. Mona Dahiya?
items.a: The clinic achieves an overall IVF success rate above 90%, peaking at over 90% for women under 30. For patients under 35, frozen blastocyst transfers yield a 65% to 80% clinical pregnancy rate per transfer. Even in complex scenarios—such as low AMH levels or recurrent implantation failures—cumulative success rates stay above 65%.

items.q: How much does IVF cost?
items.a: ₹1.5 lakh to ₹2.5 lakh for a complete cycle in most cases, with EMI options available.

items.q: Does age affect IVF success?
items.a: Yes. Success is highest under 35 and falls after 38 to 40 as egg quality declines, so early evaluation helps.

items.q: How many IVF cycles might I need?
items.a: Many couples conceive in 1 or 2 cycles; cumulative chances rise with each cycle, especially when spare embryos are frozen.

items.q: Can PCOS or endometriosis affect IVF?
items.a: Both can be managed well: OHSS-safe protocols for PCOS, and egg-sparing plans or surgery first for endometriosis.

items.q: Is sex selection allowed with IVF in India?
items.a: No. It is prohibited by the ART Act and the PC-PNDT Act and is never offered.

items.q: What are the age limits for IVF in India?
items.a: Under the ART (Regulation) Act, 2021, women must be 21 to 50 and men 21 to 55 when treatment starts.

items.q: Can I consult Dr. Dahiya online first?
items.a: Yes. An online consultation costs ₹1,000 in India or US$25 internationally.

items.q: Where can I consult Dr. Mona Dahiya?
items.a: At 3 clinics: Noida (3rd Floor, K-06, above FirstCry, Baraula, Sector 49, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301), Ghaziabad (2nd Floor, RDC, C-53A, near Bikanerwala, Sector 15, Sector 10, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201002) and Delhi (Building Number 41, First Floor, Ring Road, Block Q, Lajpat Nagar IV, Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi 110024).

items.q: Can single women have IVF in India?
items.a: Yes. Single women aged 21 to 50 can have treatment with their own eggs and donor sperm from a registered ART bank.

items.q: Does insurance cover IVF?
items.a: Standard plans usually do not; some corporate and women-centric policies do, with sub-limits and waiting periods.

items.q: How do I book an appointment with Dr. Mona Dahiya?
items.a: You may WhatsApp, Email or Call our clinic reception desk at +91 92679 82924. You may also email us at info@drmonadahiya.com. Once we receive your request we will confirm your appointment as per clinic location you prefer to visit (Noida clinic, Ghaziabad clinic or South Delhi clinic) and doctor availability.

items.q: Should both partners come to the first visit?
items.a: Yes. Although women typically have more tests, we advise that both partners attend the initial consultation so we can test both partners at the same time. Since male infertility is found in approximately 50% of infertile couples, this rule will save you a return visit.

items.q: Can I book through Practo or other third-party apps?
items.a: No. We do not accept bookings through third party sources. Only appointments made through Dr Mona Dahiya's official WhatsApp, office phone number or website are allowed. Our patients bookings are permitted through these official means only. This allows your case to be reviewed directly by the physician and scheduled appropriately.

items.q: How much does the first consultation cost?
items.a: Our receptionist will inform you of the cost once you book online. The fees for Online Consultations is ₹1000 only. The cost for visiting any of our clinics will be provided by our receptionist when you call/email/WhatsApp to book an appointment.

items.q: What should I bring to my first appointment?
items.a: Please bring all your previous medical records with you including semen analysis reports, IUI/IVF cycles (if any) along with all ultrasound scan and blood test reports from the past 6-12 months.

items.q: Is there parking or metro access?
items.a: Visit clinic in Noida: Our clinic is located 3 minutes walk from Sector 50 metro station (Aqua line). Visit clinic in Delhi: Clinic is about 5 minutes walk from Lajpat Nagar metro station. Visit clinic in Ghaziabad: Clinic is located centrally at Raj Nagar District centre.

items.q: How soon will my appointment be confirmed?
items.a: Once we confirm your appointment you will receive a confirmation message by SMS or WhatsApp within 2 hours. We will also provide you with the map location of our clinic and instructions prior to your visit.

items.q: Can I reschedule or cancel my appointment?
items.a: Life happens. If you need to change or cancel your appointment, give us a call or WhatsApp as soon as possible. Please read our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

items.q: What are the clinic timings?
items.a: Our clinics located in Noida, Ghaziabad and Delhi are open Monday through Saturday from 10AM-5PM.

items.q: Do I need a referral letter?
items.a: No. Self referrals are accepted.

items.q: Can I book an online consultation instead?
items.a: Yes there will be a fee for online consultations. ₹1000 INR for Indian Nationals. $25 USD for International Patients. Click Here to go to Online Consultation Page.
